releases.body:
## 1.7.1.0
 
 ### 本版本较为重要，请务必更新
-  注：
- 我们找到了导致碰水闪退和游戏卡岩闪退的问题，请务必更新该版本来修复解决，同时我们大幅优化了性能
- 商城新增Xbox手柄插件：支持调整手柄灵敏度、自定义地图打开快捷键、键鼠热切换(全局)。
 
 一、主插件
1. 恢复镜头阻尼控制，新增“禁用视角输入平滑”和“禁用镜头平滑过渡”开关。
2. 修复秘境奖励领取界面出现多余选项的问题。
 二、插件管理
3. 新增轻量模式，接入 Lite 插件，支持在轻量模式与标准模式之间切换。
4. 增加游戏更新期间自动切换轻量模式的功能，并新增“忽略使用限制”开关。
5. 增加轻量插件重新安装入口和“停止切换”按钮。
6. 增加插件设置项收藏、置顶和鼠标框选，支持批量开启、关闭、收藏及取消收藏。
7. 增加同名插件 DLL 冲突检测和冲突文件清理。
8. 增加插件文件被占用及轻量插件缺失提示。
9. 修复预设快捷方式不生效的问题，并支持自定义快捷方式名称。
三、米游社与账号功能
10. 新增米游社帖子浏览，支持查看官方资讯、关注动态、米游社收藏，以及搜索帖子和查看浏览历史。
11. 增加帖子与评论点赞、发表评论、回复和本地收藏。
12. 支持 B 服（世界树）角色使用米游社功能，并增加角色和服务器切换。
13. 改进多账号、多角色情况下的祈愿记录获取。
14. 新增识屏扫码，支持普通扫码、持续扫码和自动确认登录，可识别米哈游通行证及旗下游戏的国服登录二维码。
15. 修复便签查询和部分数据显示问题，优化便签刷新。
16. 增加便签人机验证来源提示及提示开关。
 四、启动器、安装与更新
17. 增加开机自启开关，安装时也可直接选择是否启用开机自启。
18. 优化设置页面加载，修复搜索结果仍显示已隐藏设置项的问题。
19. 增加“游戏中暂停启动器公告”开关。
20. 修复深色模式下更新公告内容显示异常的问题。
21. 修复更新公告中的“立即更新”按钮无法直接启动更新器的问题。
22. 增加在 Edge 中打开公告的入口。
23. 安装器增加深色模式界面。
24. 安装器增加运行环境检测，可自动补齐必要组件。
25. 降低更新器的系统版本要求至 Windows 10 1909。
26. 调整更新下载线路，并增加正式版更新包数字签名校验。
27. 补全部分插件管理页面及提示的多语言适配。
五、认证与访问管理
28. 新增插件数字签名校验、证书信任管理，以及首次使用时的证书安装引导。
29. 新增 UID 访问限制检查及申诉入口。
六、性能与动画优化
30. 优化进入设置页面时卡顿的问题。
31. 优化进入插件配置页面配置项越多约卡的问题。
32. 优化进入第三方插件配

恢复秘境领取选项开关，新增防检测弹窗开关控制
优化部分功能，修复一些Bug
​修复插件性能低下问题，修复显示器序列颠倒问题
​适配自由视角、镜头偏移和水下角色马赛克移除，启动器增加背景图/视频下载
1.7.0.0更新，写累了不想写了，修复了一些bug增加或移除了一些功能，适配7.1国服和国际服

### A third-party launcher for Genshin Impact, supporting game injection, auto check-in, and some practical utility features. **If you find this project helpful, please consider giving it a Star to support the development.** #### [Official Website](https://fu1.fun/) #### [Injection Module Open Source Repository](https://github.com/CodeCubist/FufuLauncher.UnlockerIsland) #### [中文](./README-CN.md) ### Before asking a question, please check if you have updated to the latest version. And please add tags to your questions! ## Main Features * Account Management: Quick switching between multiple accounts without re-entering passwords, with QR, password, and SMS login * Auto Check-in: One-click game, community, and cloud-game check-ins, batch mode, and a reward calendar * Game Management: Auto-detect game paths, real-time version announcements, redeem-code reminders, and server switching * Download & Update: In-app game download, diff update, pre-download, file verification, and repair * Launch Parameters: Custom resolution, window mode, monitor, and other settings * Daily Note: Resin, commissions, home coins, expeditions, and transformer status at a glance * Gacha Analysis: Import wish history and view pity and rarity statistics * Achievements: Browse and refresh achievement progress * Backpack: Inspect in-game weapons, artifacts, and materials * Data Center: Character usage and ownership stats, Spiral Abyss rankings, team compositions, and banner forecasts, exportable to PDF * Plugin Store: Browse, install, and update plugins with mirror acceleration * Calculator: Built-in character progression calculator * Utilities: Keyboard/mouse auto-clicker, FPS overlay, screenshot gallery, and external program launch * Personalization: Light/dark themes, acrylic/mica backdrop, custom colors, and card layout options * Backgrounds: Custom image or video backgrounds, slideshow, and online backgrounds * Injection: Optional injection module for extended in-game customization ## How to Use * **Upon opening for the first time**, a user agreement will be displayed. You must agree to it before use; please read it carefully! * Go to the "**Settings**" page to select the game installation path, **it is best to agree with the auto-detected path** * Log in to your Miyoushe account on the "**Account**" page. Return to the home page to use the check-in feature * Click "**Click to start game**" on the main interface to launch the game ## Notes * Switching accounts requires **administrator privileges** * **Try not to select the game path in administrator mode**; select it first, then run as administrator * The injection feature requires **running the program as an administrator** * Custom backgrounds support both image and video files; **dynamic video backgrounds are relatively unstable, while images work normally** ## Notice * Please install any version of **.NET 8.0** or above and the **Webview2** runtime before using this project * This project is for learning and communication purposes only; please support the official genuine game. ## Supported Languages -es--MX-informational) -pt--BR-informational) ## Sponsors ### [ Code signing provided by SignPath](https://signpath.org) Free code signing is provided by [SignPath.io](https://about.signpath.io), and the certificate is provided by [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org). ## Contributors and Reviewers
readmeHtml:
FufuLauncher

A third-party launcher for Genshin Impact, supporting game injection, auto check-in, and some practical utility features.

If you find this project helpful, please consider giving it a Star to support the development.

Official Website

Injection Module Open Source Repository

中文

Before asking a question, please check if you have updated to the latest version. And please add tags to your questions!

Main Features

  • Account Management: Quick switching between multiple accounts without re-entering passwords, with QR, password, and SMS login
  • Auto Check-in: One-click game, community, and cloud-game check-ins, batch mode, and a reward calendar
  • Game Management: Auto-detect game paths, real-time version announcements, redeem-code reminders, and server switching
  • Download & Update: In-app game download, diff update, pre-download, file verification, and repair
  • Launch Parameters: Custom resolution, window mode, monitor, and other settings
  • Daily Note: Resin, commissions, home coins, expeditions, and transformer status at a glance
  • Gacha Analysis: Import wish history and view pity and rarity statistics
  • Achievements: Browse and refresh achievement progress
  • Backpack: Inspect in-game weapons, artifacts, and materials
  • Data Center: Character usage and ownership stats, Spiral Abyss rankings, team compositions, and banner forecasts, exportable to PDF
  • Plugin Store: Browse, install, and update plugins with mirror acceleration
  • Calculator: Built-in character progression calculator
  • Utilities: Keyboard/mouse auto-clicker, FPS overlay, screenshot gallery, and external program launch
  • Personalization: Light/dark themes, acrylic/mica backdrop, custom colors, and card layout options
  • Backgrounds: Custom image or video backgrounds, slideshow, and online backgrounds
  • Injection: Optional injection module for extended in-game customization

How to Use

  • Upon opening for the first time, a user agreement will be displayed. You must agree to it before use; please read it carefully!
  • Go to the "Settings" page to select the game installation path, it is best to agree with the auto-detected path
  • Log in to your Miyoushe account on the "Account" page. Return to the home page to use the check-in feature
  • Click "Click to start game" on the main interface to launch the game

Notes

  • Switching accounts requires administrator privileges
  • Try not to select the game path in administrator mode; select it first, then run as administrator
  • The injection feature requires running the program as an administrator
  • Custom backgrounds support both image and video files; dynamic video backgrounds are relatively unstable, while images work normally

Notice

  • Please install any version of .NET 8.0 or above and the Webview2 runtime before using this project
  • This project is for learning and communication purposes only; please support the official genuine game.

Supported Languages

aiSummary.oneLiner: A customizable game launcher specifically built to manage mod installations and environments for supported titles.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: FufuLauncher provides a streamlined, centralized interface for managing game installations, complex modifications, and updates for supported titles, acting as a direct alternative to standard game clients. It significantly simplifies the modding experience by automatically resolving dependencies, managing specific load orders, and offering granular control over environment variables. The launcher utilizes a modular architecture to support multiple isolated instances of a game, ensuring that different modpacks or server configurations never conflict with one another. It focuses heavily on stability and performance tweaking, offering a clean graphical interface to adjust Java runtime arguments and memory allocation.
keyFeatures: Automated mod management: Allows users to easily install, organize, and toggle specific modifications without risking corruption of base game files.
Intelligent dependency resolution: Automatically identifies, downloads, and installs necessary libraries or frameworks required by specific mods.
Strict version control: Facilitates instantly switching between different core versions of a game to maintain compatibility with older mod ecosystems.
Environment configuration UI: Provides a graphical interface to tweak complex launch parameters, memory allocation, and specific JVM arguments.
Multi-instance isolation: Maintains entirely separate game environments, save files, and configurations for different servers or modpacks.
Background synchronization: Keeps the base game client and installed modifications up to date automatically.
Offline execution: Permits launching and playing configured game instances without requiring an active connection to authentication servers.

useCases.title: Complex modpack installation
useCases.description: Players can install massive, multi-layered modpacks with a single click, allowing the launcher to handle all underlying framework dependencies.

useCases.title: Server specific instances
useCases.description: Users can maintain separate, completely isolated game environments tailored for different multiplayer servers.

useCases.title: Hardware performance tuning
useCases.description: Power users can adjust memory limits and garbage collection arguments to optimize game performance for heavy mod loads.

useCases.title: Offline gaming access
useCases.description: Players traveling without internet access can boot directly into their configured instances bypassing online DRM checks.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: FufuLauncher is for gamers, mod developers, and server administrators who require precise control over their game environments and modifications. It is accessible to general users but caters heavily to power users.
aiSummary.gettingStarted: Download the latest executable release from the GitHub releases page.
